functions.formatNumber:
Die getal as teks geskryf.

format is “commas” (die verstek), “percent”, “humanize”, “bytes_binary”, “bytes_decimal” of een van die geldeenheidkodes hieronder.

precision bepaal hoeveel desimale plekke gewys word, van 0 tot 12.

Geldeenheidkodes: “usd”, “aud”, “cad”, “sgd”, “eur”, “gbp”, “jpy”, “rub”, “inr”, “krw”, “cny”, “brl”, “try”, “idr”, “chf”, “hkd”, “nzd”, “sek”, “nok”, “mxn”, “zar”, “twd”, “dkk”, “pln”, “thb”, “huf”, “czk”, “ils”, “clp”, “php”, “aed”, “cop”, “sar”, “myr”, “ron”, “ars”, “uyu”, “pen”, “vnd”, “pkr”, “ngn”.
